info.title: Goldberry API
info.description: Goldberry's JSON API (ADR 0015). Amounts are integers in minor units (cents for USD); the household currency says what a unit is. Times are RFC 3339 in UTC. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer gb_…`; tokens are minted on a parent's People page. Errors share one shape and a stable `code`.

total.description: Sum of jar balances, minor units.

split_bps.description: Share of a split deposit, in basis points (10000 = 100%).

amount.description: Signed minor units: credits positive, debits negative.

replayed.description: True when the idempotency key had been used: nothing new was posted and these are the original entries.

shares.description: Jar ID → basis points. Every jar of the kid, totalling 10000.

amount.description: Minor units, always positive; direction says which way.

jar_id.description: The jar to use. Default: the kid's first jar (Spend).

use_split.description: Deposits only: split across jars by the kid's split.

effective_at.description: Backdate the entry: an RFC3339 time or a YYYY-MM-DD date (midnight, household time zone). Default: now. Not in the future, not before 2000-01-01. Use it to load money tracked elsewhere.
